comparator.name: Bachelor Industrial Design
comparator.sourceNotes: The current ordinary after-2023 cohort guide, 2026–2027 programme diagram and after-revision PER were freshly retrieved and inspected on 8 October 2026. The ordinary diagram provides 23 positions totaling 180 (60/60/60): core 120, ITEC 10 and profiling 50. Article 3.4 of the current PER instead states core 125, while Appendix 2 retains 50 elective/profiling EC; with ITEC 10 this formally totals 185. No authoritative reconciliation was found in the bounded current-source check. Accordingly these are source-printed diagram allocations, not a resolved formal 180 pathway. No credit is adjusted to force agreement. The September 2025-specific variant and pre-2023 curriculum are not combined with this ordinary current diagram. CBL projects DPB110/DPB120/DPB240/DPB390 carry 10/10/10/20 respectively (50 total); Multidisciplinary CBL 4CBLW00 is a separate 5. Professional and Personal Development DLB384/385/386 each carry 5 (15 total) within the 180, rather than embedded or additional credits. MyFuture is embedded in that credited learning line and is not separately mandatory under the current pilot provision. External Learning Activities 25 allow approved internship/exchange/minor/elective alternatives; internship is not universally compulsory and this is not a named graduation track. DAB100 is Making Sense of Sensors (Data and Systems). DPB240 requires DPB110; DLB385 requires DLB384 and DPB110; DLB386 requires DLB384, DPB110, DLB385 and DPB240. For entrants after 31 August 2026, BEP admission requires 120 credits, compulsory first-year components, DPB240/DCB200/3PHYS/DLB385 and a signed Formal Approval Form approved through PlanApp. ELA routes retain their distinct admission and approval conditions; no generic guaranteed placement or timetable is inferred. The formal credit conflict must be corrected or explained by an authoritative source before first-stage closure. No recurring monitoring or automatic further research round is scheduled.
